_comment: Counts only, measured read-only in production on 2026-10-06 over records with status active / available. units = state x ledger; county_units = state x county x ledger (the same read; units equal the county sums, pinned by a test). visible = publication_status NULL or APPROVED / APPROVED_GRANDFATHERED (the enforced customer view; the Detroit customer subset is not applied here). authoritative_coordinates = coordinates whose field_provenance source is a parcel layer, the tax roll, a land bank or an official list; unrecorded_coordinates have no recorded origin; vendor_coordinates come from a vendor listing. imagery_capable = coordinates and no '' imagery sentinel. auction_url counts url_auction, which Available sources also use for their official list page.
